events_minors_need_authorization.name: events_minors_need_authorization
events_minors_need_authorization.value: not "events"."allows_minors" or ("events"."ends_at" is not null and length(btrim(coalesce("events"."judicial_authorization", ''))) > 0)

users_cliente_has_cpf.name: users_cliente_has_cpf
users_cliente_has_cpf.value: "users"."role" <> 'cliente' or "users"."cpf" is not null or "users"."anonymized_at" is not null

orders_paid_has_paid_at.name: orders_paid_has_paid_at
orders_paid_has_paid_at.value: "orders"."status" not in ('pago', 'estornado', 'contestado', 'pago_sem_estoque') or "orders"."paid_at" is not null

tickets_used_has_usage.name: tickets_used_has_usage
tickets_used_has_usage.value: "tickets"."status" <> 'utilizado' or ("tickets"."used_at" is not null and "tickets"."validated_by" is not null)

tickets_valid_is_clean.name: tickets_valid_is_clean
tickets_valid_is_clean.value: "tickets"."status" <> 'valido' or ("tickets"."used_at" is null and "tickets"."cancelled_at" is null)

checkins_ticket_required.name: checkins_ticket_required
checkins_ticket_required.value: "checkins"."result" not in ('valido', 'ja_utilizado') or "checkins"."ticket_id" is not null
